long_pass.note: resets at counter 0 precede any frame; a reset at the peak follows the last frame. Only a reset strictly between the two would break the persistent-state requirement.

short_pass.note: resets at counter 0 precede any frame; a reset at the peak follows the last frame. Only a reset strictly between the two would break the persistent-state requirement.

rope_slots_as_recorded_by_replay_segment.disagreement: gates/gate7b/replay.replay_segment reads the frame counter AFTER inference_streaming's closing clean_kv_cache has zeroed it, so its stored rope_slots_used is 0 for every pass ever run. The peak counter above is the real slot usage. This is a reporting bug in the frozen gate code, not a behavioural one: the pass itself is unaffected, and no result in this phase uses that field.

C1_state_and_resets.note: three clean_kv_cache calls occur per pass -- replay_segment's own, inference_streaming's at entry, and its closing one -- all of them either before the first frame (counter 0) or after the last (counter at peak). No reset lands mid-stream, which is the persistent-state requirement.

C2_causality_and_C7_replay.note: the long pass has M later frames the short pass never saw; identical outputs for every frame < N mean no future image entered an earlier frame's inference, and that a replay from the declared start reproduces the stream exactly

lingbot_initialization_block.consequence: frames 0..4 attend to each other, so a frame inside the initialization block is not individually causal. Every such frame is at position <= 4, so for any anchor at position >= 4 no frame LATER THAN THE ANCHOR is ever used. The clip-reset reference has the same property over its own five frames, where ALL FIVE are one bidirectional block, so mode A is not the stricter of the two.

C3_startup_only_gauge.note: the mapper receives the scalar through ScaleState.force, after which observe() is a no-op by construction, so there is no code path by which a later frame could change the gauge

C4_metric_units.note: the sweep multiplies ONLY the pose translation; two frames' surfaces agree best when that multiplier is exactly 1, i.e. when translation carries the same metres-per-unit scalar the depth already carries. IncrementalMapper._integrate applies one scalar to both (d_m = s * depth, T[:3, 3] *= s) -- the same lines for both benchmarks, so a benchmark whose windows are too near-stationary for the probe to resolve alpha is reported as under-conditioned, never as confirmation.

C5_map_window.note: LingBot's state has seen every earlier frame of the segment, but the explicit occupancy-map window is the same five frames the reference uses

C6_completion_inputs.note: the end-to-end identity is the real check: if the grid, the channel meaning, the coordinate convention or the read-out had drifted, the frozen head could not land on the stored volume bit for bit
